scope: Existing Stage-1 occupancy arrays only; all alignment conditions, views and draws. No new model execution. Source NPZ latents omitted; NPY occupancy members copied byte-for-byte.

validated_analysis.scope: Four fitted identities and their reserved views, CFG 0, two sampling seeds. Engineering thresholds were fixed before results: aligned mean IoU >= .95 and each object mean >= .90; tested rotation directions lose <= .02 IoU for each object and retain >= .90. Not proof for all rotations, objects, seeds, or learned pose errors. No equivalence or generalization claim.
validated_analysis.validation: Complete unique coverage, source/reference hashes, historical native replay, original sampled replay, correct input grouping and common sampling noise passed.
